system.roleplaying: You have a keen sense of social status and can spot any situation where people are treated unfairly.
system.minorTwist: Who is in danger that you just spotted?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Equality
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome to protect the rights of the underprivileged and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
